rules.justification: Carries an embedded provenance document — a concrete content payload projectable as a content-addressed Asset.
Carries a concrete `value` payload (principles, constraints, hierarchies) — a content-bearing document projectable as a content-addressed Asset, distinct from the pure-semantic ontology definitions.
Corpus-level governance record (declared counts, known gaps, source hashes, status); describes the ontology as a whole and is authority metadata, not a separately projectable content payload.
Pure semantic authority defining a stored Node type; no separate content payload to project.
Pure semantic authority defining a semantic type; no separate content payload to project.
Pure semantic authority defining a relation family; no separate content payload to project.
Pure semantic authority defining a predicate; no separate content payload to project.
Pure semantic authority defining an epistemic status; no separate content payload to project.
Pure semantic authority defining a compatibility predicate; no separate content payload to project.
Physical mapping authority bound to a predicate; not a content-bearing Node.
Unresolved-binding marker; carries no projectable content and must remain a Node.
Projection governance authority declaring Node primacy; not itself content-bearing.
Projection mapping authority; declares how a Node projects, carries no projectable payload.
Attributable authorization record for a bounded conversion; governance, not content.
